bottommost_regression.rival_program:
(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let ()
      (define (wide x)
        (grid-from-fn (rows x) (* 2 (cols x))
          (lambda (r c) (at x r (if (< c (cols x)) (- (cols x) 1 c) (- c (cols x)))))))
      (define (keep x)
        (let* ((obs (objects x 0)))
          (if (null? obs) x
            (let* ((cells (obj-cells (pick-max obs obj-r2))))
              (grid-from-fn (rows x) (cols x)
                (lambda (r c) (if (member (list r c) cells) (at x r c) 0)))))))
      (define (tile x)
        (grid-from-fn (* 3 (rows x)) (cols x)
          (lambda (r c)
            (let* ((block (/ r (rows x)))
                   (rr (mod r (rows x)))
                   (src (if (zero? (mod block 2)) (- (rows x) 1 rr) rr)))
              (at x src c)))))
      (tile (keep (wide g))))))

         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((wide (lambda (r c)
                          (if (< c w) (at g r (- (- w 1) c)) (at g r (- c w))))))
             (build-grid (* 3 h)

                         (r c)
                         (let* ((block (/ r h))
                                (rr (mod r h))
                                (src-r (if (zero? (mod block 2)) (- (- h 1) rr) rr)))
                           (wide src-r c)))))))
